stories.title: Nampa, Kuna fire districts officially consolidate to form Treasure Valley Fire District
stories.summary: The Kuna and Nampa fire districts officially merged Friday into the new Treasure Valley Fire District, a move leaders say will add staff, stations and stability.

stories.title: Nampa City Council approves new food truck rules in 4-1 vote
stories.summary: Nampa City Council approved new food truck rules. Trucks can open at 6 a.m. and park overnight on private property, but water and sewer hookups stay banned.

stories.title: Idaho family drops healthcare insurance amid rising premiums, faces financial risk for medical care
stories.summary: Joshua and Ashley Durham, who run a family medical practice, face difficult choices with rising health insurance costs, now opting to pay out of pocket.

stories.title: Rain, snow taper off Tuesday but the break in wet weather is brief
stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: 'You got to restore the trust': Boise contractor and Better Business Bureau help Fruitland family scammed twice
stories.summary: The BBB and a local contractor stepped in to fix a Fruitland family's unsafe deck at no cost after they lost hundreds of thousands of dollars to two bad contractors.

stories.title: College of Idaho football earns No. 1 overall seed in NAIA playoffs
stories.summary: The Yotes head into the NAIA playoffs as the No. 1 overall seed after completing just the second undefeated regular season in program history since 1920.

stories.title: Millions expected to travel for Thanksgiving. Here's what Idahoans should know
stories.summary: After a weekend of flight disruptions nationwide, air travel is looking smoother in Boise, but AAA is urging Thanksgiving travelers to plan ahead.

stories.title: Police: Pedestrian killed after being hit by tractor-trailer on I-84 near Hazelton
stories.summary: A 40-year-old man from Nebraska was walking on I-84 east of Hazelton when he was fatally hit by a tractor-trailer, according to Idaho State Police.

stories.title: 'Sprucing things up': Boise National Forest releases Christmas tree permits
stories.summary: Families looking to keep up traditions and chop down their Christmas tree in the Boise National Forest can now purchase permits for the season.

stories.title: Rathdrum mom battling breast cancer, insurance denial has died
stories.summary: Sabrina Dilday lost her battle with triple-negative breast cancer on Thursday, November 12, according to her husband Jeffrey.

stories.title: Boise gas prices drop more than 31 cents in a week
stories.summary: Boise's average gas price fell to $4.05 per gallon on Monday, down 83.7 cents from a month ago but still above last year's level, according to GasBuddy.

stories.title: 7's Hero: Retired Boise Police Sergeant Kevin Holtry shares decade-long journey after shooting
stories.summary: Kevin Holtry looks back on that life-changing day ten years ago when he was shot five times on duty, leading to paralysis and losing his legs.
